profile.headline: MedTech Specialist | MBA & M.Eng(Biomedical Engineering) | US National Interest Waiver(Green card holder) | Multi-player
profile.summary:
I have a passion in healthcare field and am building my career only in this field by executing diverse projects to become an important person. I have the strong collaborative ability to communicate with many divisions such as R&D, Marketing, Regulatory Affairs, Usability and Manufacturing departments for the common goal. Based on my ability, I got US permanent residency in 2024. I am ready to bring positive effects to people by offering superior healthcare services for people's life.

Strong point : 
 1. Competitive healthcare project experiences in engineering, consulting, usability, and regulatory affairs
 2. Launching various healthcare products with thorough standard to maximize customer satisfaction
 3. A polite learner eager to acquire new knowledge

▶ Industries: Technology, Healthcare, Medical device

positions.title: Pro, Algorithm Development engineer, Medical device Image Processing Group
positions.description:
▶ Achievements:                       
    • Led the IVD capacity enhancement project achieving 20% capacity enhancement
     ; Analyzed over 21,000 data & developed denoising software algorithm    
    • Contributed Ultrasound point shear-wave module sales  
     ; Analyzed over 10,000 signal data & devised ultrasound software algorithm and enhanced signal stability
    • Analyzed neural network methods to find a relevant model for a different project, and built a machine learning environment on Window and lectured neural network method
     ; Generated related document for machine learning setup on Window and tested neural network to find specific feature in medical image 
    • Developed Ultrasound 2D shear-wave software
     ; offering signal calibration model & signal test software

 I had a great opportunity to develop Samsung products, learned new technologies, manufacturing processes, and management skills. So far, I am the only person who has been involved with developing every single healthcare tech products at Samsung. This made me feel proud because I contributed to Samsung's healthcare tech business as a core member. I could learn about business from Samsung, and I am confident in my career, work experience, and my ability

positions.title: Algorithm Engineer, Radiology development group
positions.description:
▶ Achievements:
    • Contributed Samsung Electronics radiology medical device system sales achieving $10 billion sales per year
      ; Analyzed over 6,000 data cases & developed product algorithm using C/C++ and Matlab
    • Expanded product lineup achieving $ 7 million sales per year through X-ray retrofit system development
      ; Designed overall product launching strategy, developed software algorithm, and generated technical report & product manual to get a sales license
    • Designed and patented a CT de-blurring algorithm considering system specifications
    • Led Angiography image contrast enhancement project and designed the overall algorithm
    • Supported sales
      - Educated product installation and product usage
      - Involved marketing brochure development

positions.description:

    • Executed manufacturing process set up project 
      ; managed vendors for accurate component delivery, carried out BOM(Bill of Material) work and saved $100,000 through negotiation with vendors
    • Supported marketing strategy development

patents.title: Ultrasonic diagnostic device and operating method thereof
patents.description: Provided is a method of processing shear wave elastography data, including: inducing a shear wave in a region of interest of an object by emitting a focused ultrasound beam onto the region of interest of the object; obtaining ultrasound images of the object in which the shear wave is induced, respectively at a plurality of time points; measuring, by using the ultrasound images, shear wave arrival times respectively at a plurality of measurement points that are separated by preset distances from a focal point where the focused ultrasound beam is focused; detecting a reverberation in the region of interest based on the measured shear wave arrival times; and displaying information about the detected reverberation.

patents.title: Tomographic device and tomographic image processing method according to same
patents.description: A tomography apparatus comprises a controller configured to acquire a point spread function (PSF) map representing a PSF that varies according to a position in a field of view (FOV) created within a gantry, and an image processor configured to acquire a final tomography image by deblurring a tomography image based on the acquired PSF map.
